pages.title: Get This Guide
pages.text: With Patchouli installed, you automatically receive a Companion Guide the first time an interaction with Herobrine opens his main panel. Each player receives it once. If your inventory is full, it drops at your feet.$(br2)It also appears in this mod's creative tab.

pages.title: Using This Guide
pages.text: Right-click while holding this guide. Browse with categories, search and bookmarks; change the game language for a translation.$(br2)The Lore Handbook stores the full story. Find fragments and record them there to unlock it.

pages.title: Make a Connection
pages.text: Interact with Herobrine to view trust, state, requests and rewards. At trust 2, claim the Lore Handbook and first fragment from Rewards.$(br2)Craft Shelter of the Creator and use it on him. The contract screen requires one Nether Star and one Dragon's Breath.

pages.title: Next Steps
pages.text: A bound Shelter recalls him and supports invitations to beds, seats and compatible work blocks. Source Flow takes you to him instead.$(br2)Companion mode unlocks at trust 50. After visiting the End Ring, check the protection toggle.$(br2)See $(l:herobrine_companion:key_items/hero_shelter)Shelter of the Creator$(/l) for contract, invitation and teleport steps. See $(l:herobrine_companion:key_items/key_recipes)Core Recipes$(/l) for other recipes.
